data.title: How Much Bitcoin Do You Need to Be a Millionaire by 2030?
data.description: Bitcoin sits nearly half off its peak, yet Wall Street's boldest forecasters still see seven figures per coin by 2030. Before you chase their math, check which stack size survives a stubborn bear market and a stalled ETF flow.
